Symptom: Velvety olive-green spots on leaves turning black. Scab-like rough spots on fruit.
Solution: Spray Captan or Mancozeb. Prune and burn infected branches. Clean fallen leaves.

Symptom: White cotton-like masses on twigs, branches, and roots. Galls on roots.
Solution: Spray Chlorpyrifos or Dimethoate. Apply granules to soil for root control. Use resistant rootstocks.

Symptom: White powdery fungal growth on leaves and shoots. Leaves curl and wither.
Solution: Spray Wettable Sulphur or Karathane. Prune infected shoots.

Symptom: Maggots feed inside the fruit causing rotting and fruit drop.
Solution: Use Methyl Eugenol pheromone traps. Bag fruits. Collect and destroy fallen fruits.

Symptom: Small, hard, shell-like insects on bark and fruit. Sucking sap causes dieback.
Solution: Spray Horticultural Oil or Imidacloprid. Prune heavily infested branches.

Symptom: Leaves turn bronze or yellow. Fine webbing on undersides of leaves.
Solution: Spray Abamectin or Wettable Sulphur. Avoid water stress.

Symptom: Bark darkens and cracks. Branches die from tip downwards.
Solution: Cut infected branches below the canker. Apply Copper paste to cuts.

Symptom: Yellowing leaves, stunted growth. Brown discoloration under bark at soil line.
Solution: Improve drainage. Drench soil with Metalaxyl or Copper fungicides.

Symptom: Spindle-shaped spots with brown margins and ashy centers. Neck rot causes panicle to fall over.
Solution: Apply Tebuconazole 250 EC or Isoprothiolane 400 EC. Use resistant varieties like Bg 403.

Symptom: Hopper burn symptoms (circular yellow patches turning brown/dry). Insects found at plant base.
Solution: Drain water from the field. Avoid excessive Urea. Spray Etofenprox or Buprofezin.

Symptom: Leaves folded longitudinally and larvae feed inside. White transparent streaks on leaves.
Solution: Release Trichogramma parasites. Apply Chlorantraniliprole (Coragen) if damage exceeds threshold.

Symptom: Water-soaked streaks on leaf edges turning yellow/white. 'Kresek' wilting in seedlings.
Solution: Use resistant varieties. Avoid high Nitrogen fertilizer. Drain the field. Apply copper-based fungicides.

Symptom: Oval grey-green spots on leaf sheath near waterline. Snake-skin pattern lesions.
Solution: Apply Hexaconazole or Validamycin. Keep bunds clean. Avoid overcrowding plants.

Symptom: Leaves roll inwards and tips dry up. Silvery streaks on leaves.
Solution: Submerge crop for 24h. Apply Imidacloprid or Thiamethoxam.

Symptom: Formation of 'Silver Shoot' or 'Onion Shoot' instead of panicle.
Solution: Apply Carbofuran granules. Plant early to avoid peak infestation.

Symptom: Sucks milk from developing grains. Grains become empty or chaffy.
Solution: Keep surroundings weed-free. Apply Etofenprox or smell-based repellents at milking stage.

Symptom: Ragged holes in leaves. Sawdust-like frass in whorls. Larvae with 'Y' on head.
Solution: Apply Spinetoram, Emamectin benzoate, or Chlorantraniliprole. Crush egg masses by hand.

Symptom: Pinholes in leaves (shot holes). Dead heart in young plants. Tunnels in stem.
Solution: Apply Carbofuran granules into leaf whorls. Intercrop with legumes.

Symptom: Long elliptical grey-green lesions on leaves. Leaves dry up like burnt.
Solution: Spray Mancozeb or Zineb. Use resistant hybrids.

Symptom: Colonies of green/black insects on tassels and leaves. Honeydew and sooty mold.
Solution: Spray Dimethoate or soap solution. Encourage ladybird beetles.

Symptom: Powdery orange-brown pustules on both sides of leaves.
Solution: Spray Tebuconazole or Mancozeb. Destroy infected residues.

Symptom: Seedlings cut at the base near soil level during the night.
Solution: Flood the field before planting. Apply Chlorpyrifos to soil.

Symptom: Chlorotic streaks on leaves. Stunted growth and 'Crazy top' appearance.
Solution: Seed treatment with Metalaxyl. Remove and burn infected plants.

Symptom: Holes in stored grains. Powder accumulation in bags.
Solution: Dry grain to <12% moisture. Store in airtight bags or treat with Neem leaf.

Symptom: Leaves become narrow, short, and upright (bunched). Dark green streaks on veins.
Solution: No cure. Inject Glyphosate to kill plant and remove completely to stop spread.

Symptom: Yellowing of older leaves. Leaves hang down (skirt). Stem splitting.
Solution: Use resistant varieties (Cavendish). Improve drainage. Quarantine infected area.

Symptom: Tunnels in the rhizome (corm). Plants weaken and topple over.
Solution: Use clean planting material. Dip suckers in Chlorpyrifos. Trap adults using cut stems.

Symptom: Small dark spots on leaves enlarging to brown streaks with grey centers.
Solution: Remove infected leaves. Spray Propiconazole or Mancozeb.

Symptom: Toppling of plants. Root knots or lesions. Stunted growth.
Solution: Dip suckers in hot water (55Â°C) before planting. Apply Neem cake.

Symptom: Colonies of insects on young leaves. Transmits Bunchy Top Virus.
Solution: Spray soap water or Imidacloprid. Remove alternate hosts.

Symptom: Black sunken spots on peel of ripening fruit. Salmon-colored ooze.
Solution: Wash fruits with Alum. Dip in hot water (50Â°C) after harvest.

Symptom: Soft rotting of the pseudostem with foul smell. Plant collapses.
Solution: Ensure good drainage. Remove affected plants. Avoid injury to trunk.

Symptom: Dark brown spots on leaves/fruits. Flower blight (flowers turn black and drop).
Solution: Spray Mancozeb during flowering. Prune trees for airflow.

Symptom: Maggots inside fruit. Fruits rot and drop. Small puncture marks.
Solution: Use Methyl Eugenol pheromone traps. Wrap fruits in paper bags.

Symptom: Wedge-shaped insects suck sap from flowers. Sooty mold develops.
Solution: Spray Imidacloprid before flowering. Inject trunk with Monocrotophos (if recommended).

Symptom: White powdery growth on flowers and young leaves. Flower drop.
Tunnels in trunk. Frass/sawdust at base. Branch dieback.
Solution: Clean tunnel with wire and inject Kerosene or insecticide. Seal with clay.

Symptom: White waxy mass on fruit stalks and leaves. Sticky honeydew.
Solution: Release ladybird predators. Spray Neem oil or Buprofezin.

Symptom: Black velvet-like coating on leaves (grows on honeydew).
Solution: Control aphids/hoppers first. Wash with starch solution.

Symptom: Water-soaked lesions on fruits/leaves which burst and release gum.
Solution: Spray Copper Oxychloride + Streptocycline. Prune infected parts.

Symptom: Cotton-like white masses on fruits/leaves. Plants stunted.
Solution: Release 'Acerophagus papayae' parasitoids (DOA rec). Do NOT spray harsh chemicals.

Symptom: Dark green rings on fruit. Yellow mosaic pattern on leaves. Shoe-string leaves.
Solution: Remove and burn infected plants. Control aphids. No cure.

Symptom: Sunken round brown spots on ripe fruit. Fruit rots.
Solution: Dip fruits in hot water (48Â°C) for 20 mins. Spray Mancozeb in field.

Symptom: Water-soaked spots on fruits/stems. White fungal growth. Stem rot.
Solution: Apply Metalaxyl. Improve drainage. Ridge planting.

Symptom: Yellow stippling on leaves. Silky webs on undersides.
Larvae infest ripening fruit causing rotting.
Solution: Harvest at color break. Use pheromone traps.

Symptom: Rotting starts at the stem end of the fruit.
Solution: Apply fungicide paste to cut stem. Handle fruits carefully.

Symptom: Yellowing of leaves. Roots decay and smell bad.
Solution: Avoid waterlogging. Drench soil with Copper fungicides.

Symptom: Holes in trunk with chewing fiber. Oozing brown liquid. Crown wilting.
Solution: Install pheromone traps. Inject trunk with systemic insecticide (Monocrotophos).

Symptom: Leaves turn grey/brown and look burnt. Undersides have galleries.
Solution: Release parasitoids (Braconids). Cut and burn infested lower leaves.

Symptom: V-shaped cuts on leaves. Holes in crown.
Solution: Use PVC pheromone traps. Apply Naphthalene balls to leaf axils.

Symptom: Triangular pale patches on nut surface. Small/deformed nuts.
Solution: Apply Neem oil + Garlic mixture. Apply recommended acaricides.

Symptom: Reddish-brown liquid oozing from cracks in trunk.
Solution: Scoop out infected tissue and apply coal tar. Apply Neem cake to roots.

Symptom: Yellowing of young heart leaf. Spear leaf rots and pulls out easily.
Solution: Apply Bordeaux mixture to crown. Remove and burn dead palms.

Symptom: Mud galleries on trunk. Damage to seedlings in nursery.
Solution: Drench soil with Chlorpyrifos or Imidacloprid.

Symptom: Greyish brown spots on leaves. Leaves dry up.
Solution: Cut and burn infected leaves. Improve Potassium fertilizer.

Symptom: Yellow oily spots on upper leaf. White cottony growth on underside.
Solution: Spray Ridomil Gold or Mancozeb. Prune for ventilation.

Symptom: White dusty powder on leaves and berries. Berries crack.
Bird's eye spots (brown with grey center) on berries/leaves.
Scab-like corky lines on berries. Leaves curl.
Solution: Spray Fipronil or Spinosad. Remove weeds.

Symptom: Sticky honeydew and white wax on bunches.
Shot holes in canes. Vine dieback.
Grey mould on ripening berries. Berries rot.
Solution: Avoid injury to berries. Spray Fenhexamid.

Symptom: Interveinal yellowing (Magnesium) or leaf scorching (Potassium).
Solution: Apply Dolomite and Muriate of Potash based on soil test.

Symptom: Holes in fruit with excreta. Fruit rots and drops.
Solution: Bag fruits with paper. Spray Spinosad or Indoxacarb. Remove infested fruits.

Symptom: Small water-soaked spots on leaves/fruits. Oily appearance. Cracking.
Solution: Spray Streptocycline + Copper Oxychloride. Prune heavily.

Symptom: Fruits crack open exposing arils. Not a pest (Abiotic).
Solution: Maintain regular irrigation. Spray Boron and Calcium.

Symptom: Suck sap from tender shoots. Sooty mold.
Scars on fruit rind reducing market value.
Yellowing of leaves. One branch dies followed by whole tree.
Black spots on fruits and leaves.
White mass on calyx of fruit.
Maggots in fruit. Fruit rotting.
Solution: Use pheromone traps. Wrap fruits. Destroy fallen fruits.

Symptom: Yellow angular spots on leaves. Leaves dry up.
Solution: Spray Metalaxyl or Mancozeb. Avoid overhead irrigation.

Symptom: Tips of vine curl up. Silvering of leaves.
Orange beetles eat leaves causing holes. Larvae damage roots.
Solution: Apply Carbaryl dust. Hand pick beetles in morning.

Symptom: One side of vine wilts. Vascular browning in stem.
Solution: Use resistant varieties. Graft onto pumpkin rootstock.

Symptom: Buds die. Spotted fruit.
Serpentine tunnels (white lines) on leaves.
Brown gummy ooze from stem. Leaves yellow.
Angular yellow spots limited by veins.
White powder on leaves.
Maggots bore into fruit.
Leaves curl and yellow. Honeydew.
Fruit decays in contact with soil.
Solution: Use mulch to keep fruit off soil.

Symptom: Mottled yellow/green leaves. Stunted.
White trails on leaves.
Webbing on undersides. Leaves yellow.
Mottled leaves (asymmetrical yellowing). Green, bitter, deformed fruit.
Solution: Control Psyllid vector. Remove infected trees. No cure.

Symptom: Corky raised lesions on fruit/leaves with yellow halo.
Solution: Spray Copper fungicides. Prune infected twigs.

Symptom: Silvery tunnels on young leaves. Leaves curl.
Solution: Spray Abamectin or Spinosad on new flush.

Symptom: Gum oozing from bark. Bark rotting at base.
Solution: Scrape bark and apply Bordeaux paste. Drench soil with Metalaxyl.

Symptom: Larvae inside fruit. Fruit drop.
Caterpillar eats leaves (Bird dropping stage & Green stage).
Solution: Hand pick larvae. Spray BT or Carbaryl.

Symptom: Black/Green insects on new flush. Transmits Tristeza virus.
Black coating on leaves.
Bright yellow patches on leaves. Stunted plants.
Solution: Control Whitefly vector with Imidacloprid. Grow resistant varieties (MI 6).

Symptom: Larvae bore holes in pods.
White powder on leaves.
Brown sunken spots on pods.
Seedlings wilt. Stem swollen/cracked at base.
Beetles eat flowers reducing yield.
Solution: Hand pick (wear gloves). Smoke the field.

Symptom: Circular brown spots on leaves.
Circular spots with dark brown margins and black dots.
Leaves droop and turn yellow. Internal stem discoloration.
Solution: Treat seeds with Trichoderma. Deep ploughing.

Symptom: Larvae feed on leaves and bore into pods eating seeds.
Solution: Install pheromone traps. Spray Emamectin benzoate.

Symptom: Plants dry up suddenly. Roots are brittle.
Solution: Avoid moisture stress. Treat seeds with Carbendazim.

Symptom: Grey fungal mass on flowers and pods.
Young seedlings cut at ground level.
Rotting of stem at soil surface.
Plants stunted. Leaves turn reddish-brown.
Orange-yellow powdery spots on undersides of leaves.
Solution: Spray Bordeaux mixture. Prune shade trees.

Symptom: Small hole near the tip of the berry.
Twigs dry from tip downwards.
Solution: Prune infected twigs. Spray Copper fungicides.

Green flat insects on leaves.
Ridges on trunk. Yellowing leaves.
Root knots. Yellowing.
Blackening of leaves/berries.
Insects suck sap. Sticky honeydew.
Angular water-soaked spots. Black arm lesions.

Symptom: Larvae feed inside bolls.
Solution: Use pheromone traps. Grow BT cotton.
